target.optionsJson: ["gametogenesis","sporulation","sexual reproduction in Spirogyra","sexual reproduction in Rhizopus"]
target.currentExplanation: The diagram likely shows conjugation in Spirogyra, where two filaments align and form conjugation tubes to transfer gametes. Gametogenesis is gamete formation, sporulation is spore formation, and Rhizopus reproduction is different.
target.replacementExplanation: The diagram shows fusion of compatible Rhizopus gametangia and formation of a zygospore. This is sexual reproduction in Rhizopus; with the supplied option order, it is option D.
